description: Sort lines A-Z or Z-A, numeric or by length, reverse them, or shuffle randomly.

faqs.a: Numeric sort extracts the first number found in each line and orders by it, so "Item 2" comes before "Item 10". Lines with no number sort first.
Yes — the Fisher-Yates shuffle picks each position uniformly at random, so every ordering is equally likely.
No. All sorting happens in your browser; your text never leaves your device.

howto: Paste your lines into the text area.
Pick a mode: A-Z, Z-A, numeric, by length, reverse or shuffle.
Copy or download the result from the output box.
title: Line Sorter
